claims.claim_text: CVE-2026-31694 的分析顯示...namelen 衝到 4095 bytes 時，記錄長度變成 4120 bytes，超出 4096 bytes 的 PAGE_SIZE，memcpy 就把 24 bytes 寫出頁面邊界外。修補在今年 4 月才合併進主線。
claims.evidence: reclen = FUSE_REC_ALIGN(24 + 4095) = 4120; overflow = 4120 - 4096 = 24 bytes; merged upstream as 51a8de6c50bf9 on 20 April 2026.
claims.note: all five sub-facts matched source verbatim.

claims.claim_text: Meta 把 AI 儲存的骨幹換成 Tectonic...搭配三層快取，整套系統在餵養數十萬顆 GPU 訓練時仍能維持 80% 的快取命中率。
claims.evidence: In practice we observe an average cache hit rate of 80% on the distributed data cache.

claims.claim_text: Square 公開的事後分析指出，一次例行的安全憑證包更新，讓支付系統無法正常跟資料庫通訊...時間軸從 19:40 UTC 憑證部署開始，到 22:13 UTC 完全恢復。
claims.evidence: 19:40 UTC: A routine update to a security certificate bundle was applied ... 22:13 UTC: The incident is fully resolved.
claims.note: cause, manual-process root cause, and timeline all verified verbatim.

claims.claim_text: Uber 用 profiler 發現 goroutine 的預設 2KB 起始堆疊...上線後堆疊增長造成的 CPU 成本從約 10% 降到不到 1%，代價是每個 16GB container 多付不到 2% 的記憶體。
claims.evidence: 9.77% -> 0.79% CPU; 200MB overhead is less than 2% of 16GB container.

claims.claim_text: 一篇部落格文章指出 Claude Code 疑似在對外請求中植入了不易察覺的隱寫標記，作者在 Lobsters 上引發熱烈討論。
claims.note: source thereallo.dev returned HTTP 403 on both attempts; lede already hedged ('疑似', '若屬實'). No further hedge needed.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 的 Monetization Gateway 建在 x402 這個開放協定上...一秒內完成整個流程，不需要事先申請帳號或 API key。
claims.evidence: the server responds with 402 Payment Required...A facilitator verifies, and the server returns the resource. / payments can settle in under a second.
claims.note: all sub-facts verified at stated strength.

claims.claim_text: Optimistic Provide 改用統計估計網路規模...Kubo v0.39.0 上線後延遲從約 15 秒降到約 0.7 秒，網路開銷還減少 40%，北美與歐洲九成請求做到次秒級寫入。
claims.evidence: from an average of ~15s to ~0.7s; reduces network overhead by 40%; enables sub-second PUT operations for 90% of requests from North America and Europe.

claims.claim_text: GitHub 檢視自家防禦系統時發現，過去因應濫用事件臨時上線的流量限制規則，從未被重新審視就一直留在生產環境——這些規則正在誤傷約 0.003%–0.004% 的正常流量。
claims.evidence: approximately 3-4 requests per 100,000 (0.003-0.004%) were incorrectly blocked.

claims.claim_text: 而在符合可疑指紋的請求中，只有約 0.5%–0.9% 同時觸發了商業邏輯規則而被實際擋下。
claims.evidence: Among requests that matched the suspicious fingerprints, only about 0.5-0.9% were actually blocked; specifically, those that also triggered the business-logic rules.
claims.note: corrected from meaning-inflation: original prose misframed 0.5-0.9% as false-positive rate of legitimate traffic; now correctly states it is the fraction of fingerprint-matched requests blocked.

claims.claim_text: GitHub 把 Copilot secret scanning 從純 regex 換成理解上下文的 LLM 判斷...正式版上線後鏡像測試顯示誤判率降低 94%，目前已在約 35% 的 GitHub Secret Protection 儲存庫上偵測到真實密碼。
claims.evidence: we saw a 94% reduction in false positives across organizations! / Copilot secret scanning is now detecting passwords on nearly 35% of all GitHub Secret Protection repositories.

claims.claim_text: Microsoft 這篇教學把「agent harness」講清楚...作者稱這種全功能、command-line 風格的成品叫「claw」。
claims.evidence: a harness that gives it: tools it can call, a plan it can follow and adapt, memory... / A claw is just a harness.
